cohort: The study included 170,253 most recent births from the National Family Health Survey (NFHS-5) 2019-21 in India.
finding: Maternal obstetric and anthropometric factors such as lack of antenatal care, previous caesarean delivery, and short-stature mothers were positively associated with adverse birth outcomes like LBW and PTB.
mod_finding: A previous caesarean delivery was positively associated with adverse birth outcomes such as LBW and PTB.
